name: open-computer-use
description: Open-source cross-platform Computer Use with a persistent JavaScript REPL.

interface.shortDescription: Control desktop apps from Codex with the open local server
interface.longDescription: Open Computer Use packages this repository's open-source desktop automation server as a Codex plugin. The model-facing surface is a persistent Node.js REPL with js and js_reset, while the adapter composes the native accessibility and input actions through an asynchronous cua API on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the current UI state of this desktop app without stealing focus when possible
Open a new local document with keyboard shortcuts first, then type content without moving my real pointer unless required
Drive the fixture app with JavaScript and verify a multi-step flow in one call
